pending_interview.category: Coding/DS&A — arrays & strings, hashing, trees & graphs, recursion & dynamic programming, complexity analysis (senior-level: reasoning about it, not grinding it)
pending_interview.question: You are given an array of integers and a target sum. Write a function that returns all unique pairs of numbers in the array that add up to the target. The array may contain duplicates. Explain your approach, state its time and space complexity (time complexity is roughly "how much longer does this take as the input grows?", space complexity is "how much extra memory does it use?"), and walk through what changes if the input array is guaranteed to be sorted versus unsorted.
